regime.model: warm: models loaded before the study; one unmeasured warm-up request per arm
regime.request_boundary: from issuing the request to its last token: session creation, prompt processing, drafting, verification and orchestration are inside; model start-up is outside and reported separately
regime.request_context: fresh session per request; no prefix or prompt cache in any arm
regime.termination: exactly max_new_tokens tokens; end-of-sequence is ignored in every arm; a request that returns another number of tokens is invalid
